description: instagram: Profile. GET /v1/instagram/profile. Get a public Instagram profile as a signed-out visitor sees it, in the web_profile_info shape under data.user: id, fbid, username, full name, biography, bio links, exact follower and following counts, verification, profile picture, and the profile grid's first 12 posts (edge_owner_to_timeline_media.edges). edge_owner_to_timeline_media.count is exact when Instagram shows the full number and null when it shows a rounde Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.
